name: Rafael Motta
title: Video Engineer · Media Server Op
bio: I am passionate about audiovisual production and have decades of experience in the field. I believe in achieving success through careful design, not luck. From small-scale projects to large collaborations with industry professionals, I have gained valuable experience that has shaped my approach to storytelling through audiovisual mediums. I am always seeking new opportunities to work with talented and cool individuals, amazing production companies and bring their ideas to life. I am extremely skilled in various tools such as Barco E2, AW PremierCore (RS4 and RS6), PixelHue Q8, Disguise, Resolume, Millumin, EIC and a variety of other video production skills. These are just a few examples of my skill set as a full-service video production engineer. I am passionate about collaborating with the creative team from the start and using my engineering expertise to create an exceptional audience experience on-site. I have extensive experience in virtual events, including virtual studio setups and full xR experiences.
availableFor: Corporate · Live Events · General Sessions · Breakout Rooms · Technical Direction · Consultations
status: Open for bookings — based in South Florida, available to travel Domestic and Intl.
